user.title: Philips air purifier
user.description: Enter the IP address of a Philips purifier that uses the encrypted HTTP protocol (e.g. AC2729, AC2889, AC3829). Give the device a fixed DHCP lease.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the purifier. Check the address and that the device is on the network.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the purifier.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different purifier.

deprecated_yaml.title: Philips AirPurifier YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: The purifier at {host} was imported into the UI. Remove the `fan:` entry with `platform: philips_airpurifier` from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

deprecated_yaml_import_failed.title: Philips AirPurifier YAML import failed
deprecated_yaml_import_failed.description: The purifier at {host} from configuration.yaml could not be reached, so it was not imported. Make sure it is online and restart Home Assistant, or add it under Settings → Devices & services and remove the YAML entry.
